أبو محمد عبيد الله بن يحيى بن عبد الباقي الأذني

notes: Needs ruling (rule 11, narrated encounter): inside the story Umar speaks and Ali, named by the story, gives the definition; whether the report relays Ali as its source or only shows him in the scene is not settled, so Ali is not added
«من ولد عمار بن ياسر» is a genealogical descriptor and «بأذنة» a place: both left out of the surfaces

notes: kunya plus comma-less name is one man in each place («أبو الحسن أحمد ...», «أبو محمد عبيد الله ...»): one link each; «من ولد عمار بن ياسر» and «بأذنة» are a descent remark and a place: left out

Ali speaks and answers inside the encounter («فإذا هو علي بن أبي طالب ... فقال») and Umar is asked by a man («سأل رجل عمر»): the rules do not settle whether Ali is a link, since the saying is his answer inside a scene told by Yazid; not added, flagged for ruling (rule 11)
the last link written is Yazid b. al-Asamm, who narrates the encounter
